name: F1 Calendar
author: github.com/MarkVebeer
description: F1 Calendar: a Formula 1 race calendar with a web frontend and Discord notifications. The site and the bot run in one Node.js process on the server's allocation port. Put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front of the allocation and set PUBLIC_URL to that address. To update, use Reinstall Server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# F1 Calendar installation script
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -e

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates python3 make g++ > /dev/null

REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/MarkVebeer/F1-Calendar.git}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
DATA="${DATA_DIR:-./data}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Updating existing F1 Calendar checkout from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"
    git fetch --depth 1 origin "${BRANCH}"
    git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
    echo "Cloning F1 Calendar from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    rm -rf /tmp/f1-calendar
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" /tmp/f1-calendar
    cp -a /tmp/f1-calendar/. /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /tmp/f1-calendar
fi

# The data folder holds the SQLite databases. It is git ignored, so updates never touch it.
mkdir -p "${DATA}"
for db in f1calendar*.db; do
    if [ -e "${db}" ] && [ ! -e "${DATA}/${db}" ]; then
        echo "Moving ${db} into ${DATA}"
        mv "${db}" "${DATA}/${db}"
    fi
done

echo "Installing dependencies"
npm ci --omit=dev

echo "Building the frontend"
npm run build
rm -rf client/node_modules

echo "Checking the installation"
node -e "require('sqlite3'); require('@resvg/resvg-js')"
test -f client/dist/index.html

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "F1 Calendar installation completed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
